[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (lst: List Int) : Option Int :=
match lst with
| [] => none
| [x] => none
| x :: y :: tail =>
  let x' := x
  let y' := y
  if x' < y' then
    if tail.forall (· ≤ x') then
      some y'
    else
      none
  else
    if tail.forall (· ≤ y') then
      some x'
    else
      none
end
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma filter_get!_prop
(lst: List Int)
(i: Nat)
(h_i_lt_len: i < lst.length)
(x: Int)
(h_x_in_lst: lst.get! i = x)
(h_x_min: ∀ j, j < lst.length → lst.get! j ≤ x)
: lst.filter (· ≤ x).get! i = x :=
by
rw [List.filter_get!]
rw [h_x_in_lst]
exact h_x_min i h_i_lt_len
[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation lst
